notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it, checked against the Board's ballot proofs for every precinct and its issue list. Issue wording is from the ballot proofs.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
Local issue numbers run 1 to 20. Fulton County also numbers the Pettisville Local School District levy "Issue 3", the same number as the statewide question; both appear on Pettisville ballots.
